card.statement:
Regarding dimensions, for any $\mu\in\mathbf{Y}_{\succeq 0}$ we have

$\dim({}_{0}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu})=\langle\mu,2\rho\rangle,$

see e.g. [10, §5.10]. Using the considerations in §2.4, we deduce that if $0\preceq\nu\preceq\mu$ we have

$\dim({}_{\nu}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu})=\langle\nu,\rho\rangle+\langle\mu-\nu,2\rho\rangle,$

and if $\Gamma\in\mathfrak{P}(\nu)$ we have

(4.27)

$\dim({}_{\Gamma}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu})=|\Gamma|+\langle\mu-\nu,2\rho\rangle.$

In the “factorization” isomorphisms (4.22)–(4.23), setting $\lambda_{1}=\lambda_{2}=0$ and taking fiber products with $\{\mathcal{F}^{0}\}$ we obtain isomorphisms

(4.28)

$({}_{\nu_{1}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu_{1}}\times{}_{\nu_{2}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu_{2}})\times_{C^{\mu_{1}}\times C^{\mu_{2}}}(C^{\mu_{1}}\times C^{\mu_{2}})_{{\mathrm{disj}}}\cong\\
{}_{\nu_{1}+\nu_{2}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu_{1}+\mu_{2}}\times_{C^{\mu_{1}+\mu_{2}}}(C^{\mu_{1}}\times C^{\mu_{2}})_{{\mathrm{disj}}}$

and

(4.29)

$({}_{\Gamma_{1}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu_{1}}\times{}_{\Gamma_{2}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu_{2}})\times_{C^{\mu_{1}}\times C^{\mu_{2}}}(C^{\mu_{1}}\times C^{\mu_{2}})_{{\mathrm{disj}}}\cong\\
{}_{\Gamma_{1}\cup\Gamma_{2}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu_{1}+\mu_{2}}\times_{C^{\mu_{1}+\mu_{2}}}(C^{\mu_{1}}\times C^{\mu_{2}})_{{\mathrm{disj}}}.$

Similar isomorphisms hold for the schemes $\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}$ .

4.9. Intersection cohomology complex

Consider the canonical map

$r_{\mu}:\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}\to\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}_{U},$

see §4.6. Recall the intersection cohomology complex $\mathrm{IC}_{\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}_{U}}$ , see §3.4, and consider similarly the intersection cohomology complex $\mathrm{IC}_{\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}}$ on $\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}$ associated with the constant local system on the smooth open subscheme ${}_{0}\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}$ .
The following statement is [17, Proposition 3.6.5(a)].
card.label: Remark 4.15

paper.title: Modular intersection cohomology of Drinfeld's compactifications
paper.abstract: We compute the dimension of the cohomology of stalks of intersection cohomology complexes on Zastava schemes and Drinfeld compactifications associated with a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, in case the characteristic of the coefficients field $\Bbbk$ is good for $G$. In particular, we show that these dimensions do not depend on the choice of $\Bbbk$.
